narrative:
The FY2026 plan sets group gross profit at NOK 1,690M across 10 products and 21 markets (grouped into 6 planning markets), up +8.2% on the FY2025 actual of NOK 1,562M on revenue of NOK 7,463M. MyLINK CORE asks for double-digit GP growth — roughly NOK 1,720M — so the plan opens NOK 30M short of ambition.

The mix is moving the right way. Conversational Channels (WhatsApp Business, RCS, Viber) grow GP +30% and now carry 16.6% of group GP at 32-38% margins, while Carrier Wholesale SMS shrinks -8% at a 6% margin. A2P SMS still delivers 39% of GP, so the operator price rises announced for January are the largest single risk to GP per message.

The GP Target Advisor has three levers to close the gap: a stretch on conversational GP, verification growth from PSD3, and International OTP.

signals.title: MyLINK CORE — Group Strategy Update
signals.excerpt: Group ambition: double-digit gross profit growth driven by conversational channels, verification and platform revenue on a consolidated MyLINK CORE stack.
